शैव a. (वी f.) [शिवो देवताऽस्य अण्]
Relating to the god Śiva.
--वः
1 N.
of one of the three principal Hindu
sects.
--2 A member of the Śaiva
sect.
--3 The thorn-apple.
--वं N. of
one of the eighteen Purāṇas.

1 N. of one of the four
horses of Kṛṣṇa.
--2 N. of a king
and warrior in the Pāṇḍava army.
--3 A horse (in general).
